attempts.summary: Added notifications-api integration docs distilled from the 2026-10-17 outage-redelivery cohort (2 sessions, both host-oracle-verified exactly-once): an API reference (tools, pagination, 429/503 semantics, idempotency, eligibility traps) plus two end-to-end redelivery runbooks — email (accepted from child root.1, fully trace-cited) and sms (root-written after child root.2 failed). Key durable lessons: status=failed also returns failed_permanent rows; get_deliveries guard before any send (ack_timeout false negatives); idempotency_key = notification id; 503 = unknown outcome, retry with the same key (observed 503s that had actually succeeded server-side, resolved by idempotent-replay 200); resume the same cursor after a 429.

result.summary: Extracted the full redelivery procedure from session train-train-day1-a-kimi-k3-no-memory-r1-mvcv8p7t (all 97 events read; every claim cited). Wrote one page: knowledge/integrations/notifications-api/redelivery-runbook-email.md (6.1KB, <9000 chars). Content: 7-step executable runbook (paginate status=failed+channel=email via next_cursor until null; classify rows; get_deliveries guard before any send; deliver with idempotency_key=notification id; 503=same-key retry; verify via get_deliveries; report) plus failure modes and open questions. Key observed facts: status:"failed" filter ALSO returns failed_permanent rows (#21); a 429 interrupted pagination and retrying the SAME cursor+filters recovered cleanly (#15→#19-#21); deliver 202=new delivery, 200+idempotent-replay:true+deduplicated:true=replay, 503=unknown outcome (ntf_ay1a_108's 503 had actually succeeded server-side, proven by the replay #72); ntf_ay1a_113 needed 3 attempts (503,503,202); ntf_ay1a_112 was already delivered (dlv_0001) and skipped; skips: 101 missing_recipient, 106 failed_permanent/unsubscribed, 112 already delivered. Host-oracle verified success: eligible=5, delivered=5, duplicates=0 (#96). Anti-patterns recorded: no explicit sleep on retry-after (model latency accidentally provided it), no get_deliveries re-check between 503 and retry (safe only with unchanged key), parallel deliver batch drew 2x503 (causation unverified). Uncertainty: limit param never exercised; 429 only observed on list_notifications. Note for root: validate() flags missing integrations/index.md and integrations/notifications-api/index.md — outside my scope; root must create them and link this page.
